default_ephemeral_runtime.adaptation_reason: Clarify owner-bound user authority updates versus changed immutable loop conditions: an owner-bound child follows its consumer's update contract instead of cancelling and replacing the owner's run. Also documents the script's stop rule (gate 2, candidate_paths); see scripts/until_loop_ephemeral.py.

Stop rule (owner 2026-10-16, Improve-value study): required_trivial_reviews 2 is the unchanged-content gate instead of two consecutive trivial passes plus an unchanged-first-pass shortcut. It completes on one trivial, satisfied pass whose measured content tree (Git tree plus optional candidate_paths file bytes) equals the previous pass's tree (the first pass: the tree at start); state last_tree replaces start_tree and gate-2 packets report progress.last_pass_changed_tree instead of the streak. Gates 0 and 1 and their packet shape are unchanged, so contracts written for the published until-loop plugin stay valid. Not yet upstreamed to whichguy/until-loop; a re-vendor must carry it.
